en: The image depicts a historical black-and-white postcard featuring a large ornate fountain with multiple statues, prominently located in a public square surrounded by classical European architecture. The foreground shows the fountain with mythological figures, and the background includes a domed church or cathedral and several multi-story historic buildings. There is handwritten text along the right side and bottom, and printed text at the bottom center reads 'La Fontana in Piazza del Duomo.' The word 'Trento' appears at the top right.
